text: Very happy to find Dr Sawalee.  I needed my ear cleaned from a lfungal infection. Dr Sawalee was very kind and competent and speaks excellent English. Feel so happy to have my ear cleared. The staff at the reception have limited English but were fine to do the registration with your ID.  Dr Sawalee is popular so good to get there a bit ahead of opening time as people start to queue.

คลินิกหู คอ จมูก หมอสวลี
text:
My first impression was that the counter staff were impolite, lacking politeness and giving patients disdainful looks, as if they didn't want to serve.
The clinic has limited seating, feels cramped, and the wait for the doctor was long.
However, the doctor was polite and gave good advice.
***I urge the clinic owner to urgently improve or replace the counter staff. Patients are paying for their services, so they deserve better care. I hope the doctor reads these reviews; there are many negative comments about the counter staff.***

restaurant_name: คลินิกหู คอ จมูก หมอสวลี
text: The counter staff spoke in a very rude tone. I experienced it firsthand, and they didn't even make eye contact with customers. So I went to another clinic instead.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหู คอ จมูก หมอสวลี
text: The doctor was very polite and gave excellent advice. I felt very comfortable with the staff. However, I deducted one star because I wasn't impressed with the counter staff. They had a grumpy expression, a harsh tone of voice, and spoke in an unpleasant manner. They seemed unwilling to provide service. I hope they improve this aspect, as the reception staff are the first point of contact for patients before seeing the doctor. Such behavior can create a negative impression and discourage patients from seeking treatment. I've seen many similar reviews, and I'm not sure if they're from the same people, but this issue needs improvement.

He gave very good recommendations for treatment. Thank you.

text: The doctor is very kind and explains things clearly. She's dedicated to treating patients. The clinic atmosphere is clean, comfortable, and relaxing. The treatment fees are reasonable. I'm so glad that Krabi has such a good doctor.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหู คอ จมูก หมอสวลี
text: The doctor is lovely, skilled, and speaks politely and kindly. However, I'm deducting a star because of the counter staff. They were extremely rude, speaking without politeness, giving orders, and pointing their fingers at patients and their relatives. I noticed they did this to everyone. A patient forgot their mask and politely asked if they could enter; she said no and slammed the door in their face. They could have spoken nicely and with some courtesy. Words reflect character. I hope the doctor will carefully consider this staff member; they are damaging the clinic's reputation.
